[[File:Dramen staff detail.png|left|150px]]
The '''dramen staff''' allows players to enter [[Zanaris]] from the shed in the [[Lumbridge Swamp]] after completion of the [[Lost City]] quest. Players can obtain the staff by using a knife on a [[dramen branch]], which requires a [[Crafting]] level of 31. It is possible to return to [[Entrana]] and cut more branches from the [[Dramen tree]], although it is advised players make multiple staves upon completion of the quest, as this prevents the need for a return trip should the staff be lost. It is a [[blunt weapon]] and cannot [[autocast]] spells.

The dramen staff is required to use the [[fairy rings|fairy ring transport system]], which requires [[Fairytale_II_-_Cure_a_Queen#Unlocking_fairy_rings|partial completion]] of the [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] quest. Players who have completed the [[Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]] can use them without the staff.

During the [[Lunar Diplomacy]] quest, players upgrade their staff into a [[lunar staff]], which has the same effects, moderately better stats, can [[autocast]], and is always lost on [[death]].

The dramen staff can also be used to defeat [[Koschei the Deathless]] during [[The Fremennik Trials]] quest by smuggling in a [[Dramen branch]] and a [[knife]].
